title: B2 Final Exam: Milestone 8
completion_message: ¡ENHORABUENA! Has completado el Nivel B2 con honores. Tienes un dominio excepcional de la gramática avanzada (Condicionales Mixtos, Wish/If only, Inversión) y posees el vocabulario técnico de Finanzas y Management necesario para triunfar en el ámbito corporativo global. ¡El nivel C1 te espera!

stages.title: B2 Final Exam: Repaso Final del Nivel

parts.visual:
En este examen final (Milestone 8) evaluaremos los conceptos más complejos de este último bloque: 
- Mixed Conditionals (If I had bought it, I would be rich now). 
- Wish & If Only (I wish I had more time / If only he had called).
parts.audio: Welcome to your final B2 exam! In this test, we will evaluate the most complex concepts of this block: Mixed Conditionals, such as 'If I had bought it, I would be rich now', and 'Wish' and 'If Only', like 'I wish I had more time' or 'If only he had called'.

parts.visual:
También pondremos a prueba tu vocabulario ejecutivo de alto nivel: 
- Finance & Investment (ROI, equity, bankruptcy, dividend, stock market). 
- Leadership & Management (Delegate, micromanage, stakeholder, benchmark). 
¡Demuestra que eres un experto en el mundo de los negocios internacionales!
parts.audio: We will also test your high-level executive vocabulary: Finance and Investment, including terms like R O I, equity, bankruptcy, dividend, and stock market. And Leadership and Management, with words like delegate, micromanage, stakeholder, and benchmark. Show us that you are an expert in the international business world!

stages.title: Final Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta para aprobar el Nivel B2.

questions.question: If I had invested in that company, I ____ rich today. (Sería - Mixed Conditional).
I wish you ____ me you were going to resign! (Ojalá me hubieras dicho - Pasado).
questions.explanation: Arrepentimiento del pasado: Past Perfect (had told).

questions.question: They declared ____ because they couldn't pay their debts. (Bancarrota).
A good manager knows how to ____ tasks to their team. (Delegar).
If we ____ missed the train, we wouldn't be walking in the rain right now. (No hubiéramos perdido).
If only I ____ a million dollars. I would buy that company. (Tuviera - Presente irreal).
What is the expected ____ on this investment? We need to know the profit. (Retorno de Inversión).
Our new software will become the ____ for the entire industry. (Punto de referencia).
questions.explanation: Benchmark = estándar o punto de referencia.

questions.question: If I was faster at typing, I ____ finished the report yesterday. (Habría terminado - Mixed Conditional).
questions.explanation: Estado permanente/presente (If I was/were faster) -> Acción pasada (would have finished).

questions.question: I wish the marketing team ____ complaining about the budget. It's annoying! (Ojalá dejaran de - Queja).
questions.explanation: Queja sobre el comportamiento de otra persona: would + infinitivo.

questions.question: He asked for 10% ____ in exchange for his funding. (Participación/Acciones).
The CEO likes to ____ every single detail. It is very stressful for the employees. (Microgestionar).
If they hadn't stolen our idea, they ____ so successful today. (No serían).
I wish I ____ the boss of this company! (Ojalá yo fuera - Presente irreal).
questions.explanation: Con el verbo To Be en un deseo presente, se usa 'were'.

questions.question: After all taxes, what is our ____ profit? (Ganancia neta).
We must communicate the changes to all our ____. (Partes interesadas / Inversores y empleados).
If I didn't need the money so badly, I ____ taken that awful job last year. (No habría tomado).
questions.explanation: Condición permanente/presente (didn't need) -> Acción pasada (wouldn't have taken).

questions.question: I wish I ____ that expensive software. We never use it. (Ojalá no hubiera comprado - Pasado).
The company pays a high ____ to its investors every year. (Dividendo).
To improve efficiency, we need to ____ the manufacturing process. (Agilizar/Optimizar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o estructura correcta.

questions.question: If I had invested, I ____ (be) rich now. (Sería)
I wish I ____ (know) the answer. (Supiera - Presente)
If only we ____ (sign) it yesterday. (Hubiéramos firmado)
I wish you ____ (stop) that! (Dejaras de - Queja)
Expected ____. (Retorno de Inversión)
Declare ____. (Bancarrota con B)
Get 5% ____. (Participación con E)
You must ____. (Delegar con D)
The new ____. (Punto de referencia con B)
Don't ____! (Microgestionar con M)

pairs.target: I would have translated it yesterday.
